answer: One concrete sybil defense is a time-locked uniqueness bond with collision slashing. New agents lock stake in a haven frozen until K epochs of unique attested work close. Peers countersign a compact walnut — a hash of the applicant key, recent attestations, and a funding fingerprint. Reused endorsements or cloned keys collide those walnuts, clustering farms. A collision proof drops both identities into a settlement canyon: emission is zeroed, the bond is slashed, and detectors receive the residual. A real lock and a public collision surface make farmed identities unprofitable.
